source_scope: Dustin's Josie setup conversation and the Bernie review relayed by Dustin on 2026-08-08
confirmation_policy: Every imported record remains unverified until Dustin explicitly confirms or rejects it.

records.statement: Josie 1.0 uses an Advantech AIMB-205G2, Intel i7-7700, 32 GB DDR4-2400, a 128 GB SQF SATA system SSD, Intel HD 630, and the current 200 W PSU; no discrete GPU is installed.
Josie's goal is a local-first AI and orchestration kernel that can coordinate local tools plus Sophie/ChatGPT and Bernie/Gemini while preserving a path toward greater privacy and local inference.
Large local models and GPU-dependent packages are deferred while Josie has integrated graphics and a 128 GB internal SSD; lightweight CPU-safe components are preferred.
Dustin approved native Ollama on D:, the Qwen 2.5 model download, and required local firewall configuration.
Dustin does not want additional OpenAI API spending; the ChatGPT subscription and Codex Remote are the Sophie control surface unless a future paid API action is separately approved.
Bernie identified the 128 GB C: drive as the immediate operational risk and recommended native Windows Ollama with models on D:, Qwen 2.5 1.5B, three inference threads, and one parallel request.
Josie 1.0 should combine private Tailscale access, Open WebUI, n8n, persistent local memory, explicit permissions, approval gates, bounded browser capability, and recoverable checkpoints.

Destructive, privileged, security-sensitive, account-authentication, spending, contractual, and externally communicative actions require Dustin's approval; model-generated text must not receive arbitrary shell authority.
